nodes.description: Private string _contractVersion storing the human-readable version of the contract implementation.
Constant bytes32 role that authorizes pause() and unpause().
Constant bytes32 role that authorizes minting of new tokens.
Constant bytes32 role that authorizes UUPS upgrades and setContractVersion().
Constant bytes32 role granted during initialization but never consumed by any function.
Public initializer that wires ERC20/Pausable/AccessControl/UUPS, grants all roles to msg.sender and pre-mints 55,555,555,555 tokens.
External pause guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE).
External unpause guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE).
Arbitrary mint entry point guarded by onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) that forwards to ERC20 _mint.
Overridden ERC20 hook guarded by whenNotPaused that delegates to super and is invoked on every mint/transfer/burn.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE).
Writes the _contractVersion storage variable, guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE).
View accessor returning the stored _contractVersion.
Caller-controlled address used for role setup, role checks (_msgSender in onlyRole) and initial mint.
Internal ERC20 supply/balance mutation reachable from initialize and mint; performs state writes before the _beforeTokenTransfer callback.
UUPS _functionDelegateCall executes arbitrary delegatecall to the candidate implementation during upgrade.
Recipient address argument of mint(address,uint256).
Token amount argument of mint(address,uint256).
Source address argument of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Destination address argument of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Amount argument of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Candidate implementation address passed to _authorizeUpgrade.
New version string passed to setContractVersion.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to _setupRole for every role and to _mint during initialize, giving the caller full control.
onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before pause executes.
onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before unpause executes.
onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before mint executes.
onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE) validates _msgSender() inside _authorizeUpgrade.
onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before setContractVersion executes.
PAUSER_ROLE is the required role for the pause function.
PAUSER_ROLE is the required role for the unpause function.
MINTER_ROLE is the required role for the mint function.
UPGRADER_ROLE is the required role for _authorizeUpgrade, gating UUPS upgrades.
UPGRADER_ROLE is the required role for setContractVersion.
The to parameter is forwarded to the internal _mint target.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the internal _mint supply increase.
mint invokes the unsafe internal _mint operation.
initialize calls _mint with 55555555555 * 10 ** decimals(), an arithmetic supply computation.
The version argument is written into _contractVersion.
The newImplementation argument drives the upgrade authorization flow.
The from argument flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook body.
The to argument flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook body.
The amount argument flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook body.
setContractVersion mutates the _contractVersion state variable.
getContractVersion reads the _contractVersion state variable.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook after balance/supply state writes, an externalizable reentrancy surface.
Successful _authorizeUpgrade leads into _functionDelegateCall which executes delegatecall on the new implementation.
